subject.title: fix: Mattermost interaction token forgeable via hardcoded HMAC...

question: Should Mattermost interaction signing use an automatically durable provisioned secret, or should missing interactions.secret intentionally fail closed?
rationale: Both choices affect the security boundary and upgrade behavior for existing Mattermost button deployments, and the repository policy treats credential/config fallback changes as maintainer-sensitive.

options.title: Require Durable Credential Provisioning
options.body: Provision or persist a per-account interaction secret through supported setup, SecretRef/docs, and upgrade-tested paths before merge.

options.title: Accept Explicit Fail-Closed Upgrade
options.body: Require operators to configure interactions.secret and make the runtime, docs, and tests clearly reject unconfigured button signing instead of silently generating process-local secrets.

options.title: Pause For Replacement
options.body: Close or pause this branch and sponsor a narrower replacement once the credential model is chosen.

recommendation.title: Require Durable Credential Provisioning
recommendation.body: Provision or persist a per-account interaction secret through supported setup, SecretRef/docs, and upgrade-tested paths before merge.
